uncovered_constraints_packaged: The scheduler must pin the exact request file or literals, eight selected lines, source-file SHA-256, and canonical selected-request SHA-256; R01 stops instead of searching for or generating substitute input.

The outer scheduler already creates the formal runtime Goal, so the skill forbids create_goal; a blocked R01 is repaired and restarted in a new thread at the first incomplete Goal without accepting partial artifacts.
KFD/process exclusivity for both physical DCUs must be checked before any PyTorch, vLLM, or HIP-initializing import, and every failed attempt is preserved separately.

When checkout metadata shadows the installed vLLM distribution, enumerate all matching distributions, validate the runtime version, locate both vllm/_C.abi3.so and vllm/_rocm_C.abi3.so, and record source and extension paths and hashes.

Strict launch-owned device-row validation covers only native database-proven kernel launch APIs such as hipLaunchKernel, hipModuleLaunchKernel, and hipExtModuleLaunchKernel, not memcpy or memset APIs selected by broad substrings.

A pure offline analyzer classification defect preserves its failed log and diagnostics and reuses byte-identical raw database and pftrace inputs after the analyzer fix; it never triggers a needless DCU recapture.
The layer denominator requires one complete observed-clock interval for the same ordered eight-request set across clock and hipprof passes, with both warmups excluded.
The complete all-input-layer CSV is the R04 target-layer denominator; R01 neither requires FX-process markers nor infers process attribution from layer totals.

Historical backup outputs and prior single-card timings, traces, device mappings, runtime handoffs, and evidence cannot satisfy this fresh R01; workload_profile contributes only allowed definitions, taxonomy, marker vocabulary, schemas, and reconstruction method.

The target's cold-compile behavior requires an unmeasured first start and same-contract warm restart with cache hits, symmetric KV-cache capacity, and ready initialization/pre-capture evidence for both DP ranks.

Every acquisition and split profiler pass retains the full dual-device DP2 contract, preserves rank/native-device identity, emits per-rank/per-device artifacts, and fails the coverage gate rather than promoting a one-device result.

Business artifacts remain below runtime_artifact_root, the scheduler handoff is written only to runtime_handoff_output after all checks pass, and R02 cannot start until the handoff and hashes validate.

Small internally consistent helper/schema/report refinements do not add human review gates, while host-versus-device attribution, fixed workload, denominator conservation, and complete topology coverage remain strict stop conditions.
